scripts.build: npm run sync && npm run build:site
scripts.test: npm run sync && node --test --import tsx tests/*.test.mjs tests/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run sync && tsc --noEmit && npm run build:site && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.local.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run kv:upload && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --minify
scripts.kv:upload: wrangler kv bulk put data/kv-bulk.json --config wrangler.jsonc --binding SQLD_DOCS --remote
